people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
translations.bsb: “If You can?” echoed Jesus. “All things are possible to him who believes!”
translations.kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
translations.asv: And Jesus said unto him, If thou canst! All things are possible to him that believeth.
